The '''''Alamintari''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] bound for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] when ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of [[Garcornian spice]] was discovered in a [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]] and a pre-recorded [[sound chip]] of a [[Breshig]] [[trill beast]] to scare away [[Customs Inspector]]s.
